months.title: Palau July 2026 Visitors Arrival Summary Report
months.summary: July 2026 visitor arrivals totaled 6,963, marking a clear recovery from the June 2026 low of 5,925 and indicating a return to stronger monthly performance after the mid ‑ year easing. Arrivals in July were led by China with 2,776 visitors, followed by Taiwan (1,451), USA/Canada (1,174), Japan (771), Australia (226), Europe (216), Others (309), and South Korea (40). Month ‑ on ‑ month, arrivals increased from China, Taiwan, USA/Canada, Japan, South Korea, and Europe, while Australia and Others recorded declines.

months.title: Palau August 2026 Visitors Arrival Summary Report
months.summary: August 2026 visitor arrivals totaled 7,565, increasing by 602 visitors from July's 6,963 and continuing the recovery from the June 2026 low of 5,925. This represents the highest monthly arrival total recorded so far in the second half of the year and reflects sustained demand across several key source markets. Arrivals in August were led by China with 2,398 visitors, followed by Taiwan (1,459), Japan (1,258), Others (844), USA/Canada (843), Europe (395), Australia (300), and South Korea (68).

months.title: Palau September 2026 Visitors Arrival Summary Report
months.summary: September 2026 visitor arrivals totaled 5,343, down by 2,222 visitors, or 29%, from August's 7,565. The decline follows the same August-to-September pattern seen in 2025, when arrivals fell from 6,061 to 4,499. Although September recorded the lowest monthly total so far in 2026, arrivals remained above September last year.China remained the largest source market with 1,879 visitors, followed by Japan (966), Taiwan (763), USA/Canada (754), Others (426), Australia (268), Europe (239), and South Korea (48).

months.title: Palau October 2026 Visitors Arrival Summary Report
months.summary: October 2026 visitor arrivals totaled 5,585, up by 242 visitors, or 5%, from September's 5,343. While October's results showed an improvement over the previous month, arrivals remained below October last year. China remained the largest source market with 1,935 visitors, followed by Taiwan (873), USA/Canada (864), Japan (635), Europe (462), Australia (380), Others (346), and South Korea (90).
